description: selfFactSpec rows (v1 as a committed data file) read at use time by development-vessel's self_fact_reconcile from the git object origin/dev:scripts/substrate/self-facts.json in each node's super-repo clone. A row registers one instrument (a fact function in self-fact-reconcile.ts): the node profiles whose node holds the copies it checks, the edit site its gaps point at, and its must-fail control. An instrument with no row does not run. REALIGNMENT 2026-09-29 §2.1 items 1, 3, 4, 5. Rows with instrument journal_pattern are recurring-defect detectors (unit, pattern, max, window_hours, must_fail_line, gate); the canary fires only if the pattern matches its own must_fail_line (REALIGNMENT 2026-09-29 section 7 step 2). Rows with instrument lookup_classification check that a failed discovery lookup is never read as no producer (a per-node journal count plus planted failed lookups); rows with instrument typed_seam_sites count discovery lookup sites outside the typed ias seam against a ratcheting ceiling (max), lowered by a data commit as sites migrate, and read unobserved when any clone ref is older than max_ref_age_hours.

rows.must_fail_line: [pull-sync 2026-09-29T12:08:37+00:00] development-vessel: !!! TEST GATE BLIND — suite produced no countable result (errored or absent); converging ungated

only_tests: no predicate at all is "none" — the 99% case, and not an error

rows.must_fail: canary: a planted gap with an overlapping retry, a stage-contradicting class and an unescalated repeat refusal, plus a planted source with one unbranched checkOpNoEffect call, must all be measured; controls every run: noEffectOverlapRefusal must refuse a planted retry re-editing a no-effect span (else enforcement-not-refusing) and allow a disjoint one (else enforcement-over-refusing); fewer than min_sites branched checkOpNoEffect call sites at origin/dev is divergence gate-call-sites; retries past apply with no recorded spans make the row UNOBSERVED; a planted journaled refusal with no stored record must be measured (canary), and journaled refusals exceeding stored refusals for an unsaturated gap is divergence refusals-not-recorded
rows.notes: FOLLOW-UP: once intervention 1 lands, fold this row's git-show call-site count into I1's countSites and gate it on refAgeHours (a stale origin/dev must read unobserved, never as a count). The journal cross-check reads only this node's development-vessel journal; node 2 (compute) composes are not cross-checked unless the row is also scoped to compute.

rows.must_fail: planted failed discovery lookups through the ias typed seam (timeout: a local discovery that accepts and never answers; network: a refused port), for each probe shape, must read 'lookup failed' and no policy-reader line built from them may match the pattern; a misread is a finding. The pattern must also match its own must_fail_line.
rows.must_fail_line: [gap-to-feature] selection skipped: spend envelope envelope unreadable: no poolImpulse producer discovered

rows.must_fail: a scratch repo holding one planted site, plus a .test.ts and a .js twin that must not count, must count exactly 1 with this row pattern and pathspecs; a clone whose origin/dev was last fetched or moved more than max_ref_age_hours ago (newest of FETCH_HEAD mtime and the ref reflog time) makes the row unobserved, never a lower count
